items.html: And this will be understood by what was said above, how the three phases that ZA has—Ibur, Yenika, and Ibur of Mochin—all three of them are found in him in this first Ibur alone. And this is the first of these phases, which is now made in the secret of three alone, except that they are included in the other three; and those three, HGT, are in potential and not in actuality.
